reason: The plugin’s primary function is end-user interface customization: it adds a Wallpaper page in DSH Settings for choosing a background image and tuning frosted-glass visual tokens (blur, opacity, saturation), then applies those settings as runtime CSS overrides and saves them in localStorage for persistence. Evidence from the README and manifest shows this is a web client-facing visual/theme feature with no explicit third-party integrations in runtime code.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，提供设置页中的壁纸上传与磨砂玻璃参数调节（模糊、透明度、饱和度）功能，用于个性化界面外观。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that adds a Wallpaper settings page for uploading background images and adjusting frosted-glass effects like blur, opacity, and saturation to customize the UI.

capabilities: Local image upload and base64/data-url handling for wallpaper preview.
Client-side CSS variable/style token injection to override app background and frosted-glass appearance.
Settings UI extension under the Harness Settings panel.
Persistence of user preferences via browser localStorage.

reasons.code: README describes a Wallpaper settings page that supports uploading JPEG/PNG/WebP images and adjusting Frost, panel opacity, and saturation controls.
README states preferences are saved under localStorage key dsh.wallpaper and reapplied on boot via injected style variables.
Package manifest declares a web DSH client plugin with client entry points and optional runtime peer dependencies, indicating in-app UI extension rather than external service integration.
Repository includes bundle wiring files and patch entry points for client activation (cordis.patch.yml) in plugin distribution.
